strategies.name: Hierarchical Two-Level Reduction Tree

Exploits locality to reduce network diameter; approximately 8-10 collective dispatches but with smaller effective world sizes per operation.

strategies.name: Pipelined Overlapped Mask Computation
strategies.desc: Split each all-reduce into non-blocking operations, compute next iteration's mask and buffer while current all-reduce is in-flight. Uses async all-reduce primitives (if available) to overlap 7 rounds of communication with local masking/scaling computation. Still 8 dispatches but hides local CPU work in network time.

strategies.name: Reduce-Scatter + All-Gather Decomposition
strategies.desc:
Replace each masked all-reduce with reduce-scatter (scatter masked chunks to owners) followed by all-gather (broadcast results). Each of 7 iterations uses 2 collectives instead of 1 all-reduce, totaling 15 dispatches, but reduce-scatter can leverage ring algorithms more efficiently for partial data at large world sizes, potentially lowering per-dispatch latency.
